slides.title: Selling in Laval this winter? Read this first.
slides.sub: More listings, fewer sales and snow on the roof. Here's how to plan.

photo.credit: Île Paton, Chomedey · Photo: Laurent Bélanger, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

slides.title: Buyers have more choice right now
slides.body: That's Greater Montreal, **Laval included**. More homes to compare means your price and prep matter more.

slides.title: Price for your sector, not the island
slides.body: A Laval-wide average can mislead you. Compare your home to **recent solds** near you.
slides.source: Per Centris.ca, last 4 quarters to Q3 2026

slides.title: Snow can hide your roof
slides.body: Snow can block parts of a buyer's inspection. Keep **roof and repair invoices** ready to show the history.
slides.source: Per RE/MAX Québec and AHIT inspection guides

slides.title: Start your seller's declarations early

cards.title: Honest answers
cards.sub: To the best of your knowledge

slides.body: Pull out permits, invoices and warranties now. Not sure about something? **Ask your notary.**
slides.source: Per OACIQ (Declarations by the seller form)

slides.title: Make winter showings easy
slides.body: Short days mean evening visits. A clear path, a bright entry and a warm house help buyers stay longer.
